hero.title: Original Research on Commerce, Content and AI
hero.subtitle: Content Cucumber writes for a living, so we hold our own work to the same standard we sell. These are independent platform analyses and studies built from what practitioners told us, in their own words.

sections.title: What we publish, and how it gets made
sections.content:
Two kinds of thing live here. Platform analyses compare real systems against the requirements that break implementations, written from hands-on evaluation rather than vendor decks. Studies ask working practitioners one question and print what came back.

Brent Peterson and Isaac Morey write them. Every quote belongs to a named person who agreed to be named, and anyone who asked to stay anonymous is counted and never identified.

sections.title: Published research
sections.content: Each of these is a document you can download and read end to end.

items.question: Who writes these?
items.answer: Brent Peterson and Isaac Morey at Content Cucumber. Brent is CEO and Isaac co-founded the company.

items.question: Do I have to give my email?
items.answer: The reports are gated, so yes for those. The studies are open, and you can read a study page and answer its question without giving anything.

items.question: Can I quote from them?
items.answer: Yes, with attribution to Content Cucumber and a link back. If you want the underlying material for something you are writing, ask and we will talk.

items.question: How often does something new publish?
items.answer: When the work is finished. No calendar, no quota, and nothing gets shipped to fill a slot.
